scope.shape: optional nonempty unique list of nonempty declared facet names

candidate_and_independent_review.defect: Moving or removing a source control designation bypassed the old intersection-only canonical guard, allowing graph reapproval although direct validation rejected the source role.
candidate_and_independent_review.resolution: Direct cases and every structured canonical source share validate_case_requirement. Required facet roles, unknown/mixed facets, invalid controls and diagnostic-policy requirements are checked before graph review mutation.

role_contract: Every marked facet requires a valid positive-control case. Unmarked effect facets still require effect evidence; incompatible mixed facets are rejected.
Invalid cases cannot cover marked controls, even with a diagnostic policy. Opted-in unmarked invalid facets retain their role and diagnostic-basis requirements.
Omission inserts no default field and preserves valid existing behavior, source material, fingerprints and rendering.
Marked target facets require an explicit positive-control canonical pattern. Sources retain their actual evidence role and declared phase.
Source designation movement/removal cannot create current incompatible evidence through validation, reporting, snapshots or review.
Compile/link/run controls retain their phases; a qualified run control never becomes a runtime-effect cohort member or runtime_effect_pass.
The designation binds complete requirement/source fingerprints but grants no source, fixture or inventory approval and clears no pending facet.
SourceUses remains credit-free with pending targets; the new field does not create an inventory or execution.

main_reconciliation.README_merge: Only the reviewed41role-documentation lines were added to the newer README; existing parser documentation was retained.

validation.qualification: The690-method full run belongs to the96-catalogue correction worktree. Current main ran the247-method combined role/parser selection and exact whole-corpus default-preservation checks, not a relabelled full run.

remaining_boundaries: BCS-ROLE-001 infrastructure support is available, but the real BIND requirement is not opted in and no retention program has been authored or approved.
The two BIND-common programs require their own source/facet designation, complete implementations, observations and independent source/fixture review.
C830-CAUSE-001 and C830-ORIGIN-001 have separate diagnostic-precision work; C830-ANCHOR-001 remains unimplemented.
Assumed-size/implied-shape source review and assumed-rank authoring continue. All source/oracle/coverage gates, including the real-BOZ representation bridge, remain open.
